photo_reviews.finding: The larger exact-work file preserves all seven roundels, the prominent central sword and whole painted field. It may show modestly more native detail but does not demonstrate sufficiently material improvement to supersede the staged selected proof without further colour/reference evaluation.
photo_reviews.do_not: Do not invent seven literal swords, over-retouch craquelure, crop narrative roundels, or equate larger dimensions to better art.

photo_reviews.finding: The entire 1539 altarpiece with all fifteen Rosary mystery roundels, Virgin and Child, saints and lower angels is visible. Yorck source is cleaner along its edges and removes the problem of physical mounting clips without an artificial object-erasure edit. Its darker/less warm colour should be checked before final signoff.
photo_reviews.display_policy: object-fit contain at natural portrait ratio; no detail-substitution or cropping out any mystery

photo_reviews.finding: v1 removes most exposed oak but still leaves traces around borders, especially lower edge. The v2 proposal preserves Marian, angelic, dove and lily imagery, yet native pixel-edge check remains necessary to certify no support border or painted loss.
